compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is displaying a welcome message for a sneak peek of the Atom Tickets app. The main contents and functions highlighted in this UI screen include:

1. **Welcome Message**: A pop-up message titled "WELCOME TO THE SNEAK PEEK OF ATOM TICKETS" is displayed.
2. **Description**: The message explains that users can now use Atom Tickets to watch trailers, check showtimes, and plan their next night out with friends. It also mentions that soon users will be able to buy tickets and concessions from their favorite theater.
3. **Action Button**: There is a "GOT IT" button at the bottom of the pop-up, which users can tap to acknowledge the message and proceed.

In the background, there is a partially visible interface that seems to show movie listings and details, but it is obscured by the pop-up message.
